newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine no longer backs only GM as AvtoZAZ partner.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine no longer backs only GM as AvtoZAZ partner.

text.p: Ukraine has reversed a decision to back only General Motors Corp as a potential partner for AT AvtoZAZ, and will go ahead with an open investment tender for the carmaker, the government said.
A one-sentence decree issued by Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko this week said a decree issued earlier this month, which said the government would back only GM, was rescinded.
No explanation was given for the new decision.
"This in fact means that the competition for investment tender will go ahead," said Viktor Padalka, head of the machine-building section for the Cabinet of Ministers, told Reuters late on Wednesday.
GM and AvtoZAZ in September agreed on a $500,000 feasibility study to be completed by the end of the year, looking into joint car and light truck manufacture.

AvtoZAZ, which manufactures the mid-range Tavria car in the eastern industrial city of Zaporizhiya, is one of 208 state enterprises that the State Property Fund (FDM), the state privatisation agency, has made available for strategic investment.
The Fund, which has valued the carmaker's authorised capital at $5.32 million, planned to make 30 percent of the carmaker available to a strategic foreign or domestic investor.
Other companies, such as Korea's Daewoo Group, have also expressed interest in AvtoZAZ.
